items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism of topoi and a sheaf on its target give a commutative diagram between the localizations, with the localized morphism characterized by the description of its pullback and satisfying the identity relating the pushforward to the localization functor (statement lines 7842-7863). The proof is a complete argument: because the statement mentions only topoi, the author may replace the situation by one coming from a continuous functor between suitable sites with a representable localizing sheaf (proof lines 7866-7875); the companion localization lemma for morphisms of sites then supplies the commutative diagram (proof lines 7876-7886); and the characteristic property and the identity follow from that diagram (proof lines 7887-7892). The non-formal content is the reduction to morphisms of sites. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with each input named.
